answer.explanation: In the visible window, all four functions complete normally. REPORT lines show no timeouts, no errors and no throttling. Max memory used stays around 96-111 MB, below the configured sizes (128 MB for Uploader, 256 MB for CrudApi, 1024 MB for Thumbnailer and Compression). Uploader's 128 MB is the tightest margin, at about 98 MB used, but it is not exceeded. Init durations of roughly 450-550 ms appear only on cold starts and are consistent with normal Python 3.12 initialisation. The log is truncated after about 4,100 events, so the remainder of the window was not checked.
